claims.content: Coordinate filter activation/deletion via J7.6 messages to control track transmission

goal.raw_text: Coordinate filter activation/deletion via J7.6 messages to control track transmission

claims.content: C2 JU
The C2 JU has established communication channels (voice or other media) with all IUs for coordination of filtering requests.
The C2 JU is operating on Needline PGs and is subject to data filtering rules as defined in sub-paragraphs a. through i.
No active transmit filters are currently inhibiting transmission of tracks that meet filter criteria, unless intentionally activated per prior coordination.
The J7.6 message mechanism is available for requesting or reporting insertion/deletion of transmit filters.
The C2 JU initiates coordination with all IUs to minimize track management problems prior to activating or modifying interface filters.

trigger.raw_text: The C2 JU initiates coordination with all IUs to minimize track management problems prior to activating or modifying interface filters.

claims.content: The C2 JU coordinates with all IUs via voice or other communications media to minimize track management problems prior to activating interface filters.
The C2 JU sends a J7.6 (ACT = 0) Filter Implementation Request message to request activation of a transmit filter.

Upon receipt, any system that filters tracks/IUs must establish a transmit filter which duplicates the receive filter; if geographically defined, the transmit filter area shall be slightly larger than the reception area to prevent dual designations.

When a transmit filter is activated by a unit, the unit shall cease reporting any track for which it has R² and which meets the filter criteria, and shall comply with rules for terminating transmission of applicable track data.
Filters apply to tracks initiated prior to filter activation as well as those initiated while the filter is active.
The C2 JU may send a J7.6 (ACT = 2) Delete Filter Request/Report message to remove an existing filter.
Track filters are requested/reported in separate J7.6 messages from reference point and EW product filters, except when Unknown E/C Filter Indicator is set to value 1, allowing combined filtering.
If the storage files of a JU are filled and all applicable filters have been used, acceptance of new data shall not be required, regardless of its ID or priority.
Any track or nonC² IU with an EMG IND or FT IND set to the value of 1 shall not be filtered.
A J3.1 message shall not be filtered.
Active nonsimulated C² IUs cannot be filtered; however, C² IUs with the Simulation Indicator field set in their J2 PPLI message may be filtered.
The J7.2 Correlation message shall not be inhibited by any filter.
Targets reported in J12.7 messages shall be processed as EW Product information for the purposes of environment/category filtering.
If the storage files of a JU are filled and all applicable filters have been used, acceptance of new data shall not be required, regardless of its ID or priority.
Transmit filters are coordinated with all IUs via unique filter numbers to minimize track management problems.
Tracks eligible for transmission on the interface are those not inhibited by any currently set transmission filters.
Filters apply to tracks initiated prior to filter activation as well as tracks initiated while the filter is active.
Units cease reporting tracks for which they have R² and that meet filter criteria, complying with termination rules for applicable track data of the Environment/Category.
The J7.2 Correlation message remains uninhibited by any filter.
Targets reported in J12.7 messages are processed as EW Product information for environment/category filtering purposes.

Any system filtering tracks/IUs on receipt has established a transmit filter duplicating the receive filter; if geographically defined, the transmit filter area is slightly larger than the reception area to prevent dual designations.
